description: LEAP-2022 - Effects of overburden stress, relative density, and static shear stress on cyclic strength of Ottawa F65 sand is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Majid Manzari, George Washington University (gwu.edu). The stress-strain-strength behavior of Ottawa F-65 sand is investigated through a series of stress-controlled Cyclic Direct Simple Shear (CDSS) tests conducted as part of the Liquefaction Experiments and Analysis Project (LEAP-2022). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Confining Stress, Cyclic Direct Simple Shear Test, Liquefaction, Relative Density, Sand, Static Shear Stress. Published 2022-11-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
